crons.//: 09:30 IST. The aging reminder ladder — see app/api/cron/reminders.

The push outbox safety net. The composer fires /api/push/send directly when a message is sent, so this only catches anything that did not go out. A Hobby plan allows one run a day; on Pro, tighten this to */5 * * * * so a failed push retries within minutes rather than tomorrow.
